events.title: Beefy Boi Demo Update v1.2, NextFest
events.summary: Hi everyone, and welcome to Beefy Boi's biggest demo update yet. We had an incredible past two months since you have heard from us. Over 400 of you have tried the playtest and more than 100 have played the demo. Thank you so much for your participation, and your feedback. Based on the community feedback, we have brought in many changes, and quality of life changes to the Beefy Boi Demo. events.title: Beefy Boi Demo at Weird Days!
events.summary: Hi all, we are super happy to be apart of Weird Days: Job Simulator inaugural event. We are super proud to officially announce the first edition of our demo, if you are a content creator and would like to stream the game or make any content feel free to post anything you'd like. If you need any assets, feel free to access our Press Kit here. A special thank you to all our playtesters who helped us get the demo into a launch ready state. We left the feedback button in both the playtest and demo.

We know playtests are usually more unstable versions of the game and not as fun to play. So thank you for everyone who participated, we got a lot of work done over these past few days. events.title: Welcome to the playtest!
events.summary: Welcome to the first official Beefy Boi playtest. Make sure to watch out for updates this week, as we ramp up to the demo. We have numerous features we will be rapid firing, so stayed tuned as we release them over the next 10 days. This first playtest will be tamed however, we will quickly release updates over this time period -- the more participation the better the game will be. events.title: Mr. Meat wants YOU to help playtest!
events.summary: Hey everyone, We're excited to give an update on Beefy Boi and what you can expect over the next few months. What started as a funny game jam project prototyped in 48 hours for the So Bad It's Good Jam(shoutout), has turned into a half year project. We will be releasing the playtest this summer, followed by a late summer/early fall demo release. We will keep you posted as we progress.
